issues.evidence: Academic: the collection of subtle particles would be numerous (མང་བ = many), not large in size.
issues.fix: That bunch of tiny specks would be very many.

issues.evidence: Academic: "know, see, and resolve upon" (མོས་པར་བྱ); "understand" repeats "know" and loses the third verb (trusting/resolving).
issues.fix: should know, see, and have faith in all things in this way:

issues.span: think of a great awakening hero ... Now think of a son of a good family or a daughter of a good family. ... This person will create much more stored-up goodness.
issues.evidence: Academic: the merit of the one who writes/teaches even a four-line verse is "much more" than (compared to) the merit of the bodhisattva great being who fills world systems with the seven precious substances and gives them; the comparison between the two is the point.
issues.fix: Furthermore, Subhuti, imagine a great awakening hero who fills countless world realms with the seven precious things and gives them all away as a gift. Now imagine a son or daughter of a good family who writes down, learns, keeps, reads, understands, or fully teaches others even just a four-line verse from this perfect wisdom. This person creates much more stored-up goodness than the hero did, too great to count or measure.

issues.span: This is the Diamond Cutter perfection of perfect wisdom.
issues.evidence: Academic: a single title, "Diamond Cutter perfection of wisdom"; the added sentence repeats the title and "perfection of perfect wisdom" is redundant and confusing.
issues.fix: The noble Great Vehicle sacred text called Perfect Wisdom that Cuts Like a Diamond (the Diamond Cutter) is complete.
